title: lava services --json
description: Every container registration, with the file and line that declared it and the real resolution history: what each service actually pulled in, and who pulled it. Dependencies are recorded when a service is RESOLVED, so a service nothing has asked for yet reports none — an honest 'not known yet' rather than a guess from reading code.

services.description: In registration order: core services, then each enabled module's, then app/Services.php.

id.description: The container id — a class-string or a plain name.

target.description: For an alias, the id it resolves to; null otherwise.

file.description: Where this id was registered. For an alias, the alias() call, not its target's registration (which has its own row).

class.description: The concrete class resolved, once it has been; null before that, and for aliases and values.

dependencies.description: Ids this service resolved from the container, in resolution order.

dependents.description: Ids that resolved this one — the reverse edge, so 'what breaks if I change this' is answerable.
